runner_status: Sourced by numbered scripts; not run as a standalone analysis stage
purpose: Defines paths, batches, manual-curation helpers, clinical thresholds, the operational SNP threshold and output directories.
inputs: Project directory structure; data/manual_sample_curation.csv when available
filters_denominator: No biological filtering itself. Sets the primary culture threshold to >=1e3 CFU/mL and the operational same-strain threshold to <=25 SNPs.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: Shared constants, paths and helper functions in the R session; creates configured output directories.
safe_claim: The numbered scripts use a common configuration and common primary-analysis filters.
limitations: The <=25 threshold is recorded as prior project practice, not externally calibrated here. Sourcing the file creates directories, and software/package versions are not frozen.

purpose: Writes small dimensions, column-name and head snapshots of key generated inputs and lists existing dnadiff reports.
inputs: VF, MLST, plasmid and clinical result files; results/nucmer report paths
filters_denominator: Reads only files that exist; truncates previews to a limited number of rows and columns.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: results/within_person/debug/input_snapshot/
safe_claim: Useful only for confirming the shape and location of inputs.
limitations: Not biological evidence; dims.csv is appended and may combine runs unless managed.

runner_status: Required upstream but omitted by RUN_COMPLETE_ANALYSIS.sh
purpose: Builds the authoritative assembly-level metadata from the overview workbook, batch supplements and FASTA discovery while keeping assembler alternatives explicit.
inputs: OVERVIEW E.coli batch 1-6 - CLEAN_RC.xlsx; data/inputs/batch*.csv; ont-yellow-routine-fastas/; manual curation
filters_denominator: Overview is authoritative; batch CSVs supplement only; unlinked/unexpected and quarantined records are excluded from active episode analysis. Current file has 1,299 rows, of which 1,291 pass primary and genomics curation.
tools_tests: Biostrings supplies lightweight contig, total-size and GC metrics when installed; no inference.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: assembly_metadata.csv; results/assembly_metadata.csv; results/metadata/assembly_metadata_all_batches.csv; metadata and FASTA audit tables under results/qc/
safe_claim: Documents the expected-isolate universe, matched FASTAs, assembler alternatives and explicit exclusions.
limitations: Does not document raw-read generation, basecalling, assembly settings or polishing. Missing Biostrings causes metrics to be skipped.

analysis_unit: Raw clinical row; harmonised participant-timepoint fields
purpose: Loads available batch 1-6 clinical CSVs, harmonises names and types, separates symptom fields and retains a B1/B2 SnS fallback.
inputs: data/inputs/batch*.csv as defined in 00_config.R
filters_denominator: Loads only batch files present on disk; warns for missing batches; harmonises Participant_id and Timepoint without assigning the final outcome.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Repeated raw records are retained for episode-level collapse in script 00b.
outputs: results/clinical/intermediate/clinical_merged.rds; detected symptom-column audit
safe_claim: The clinical source files were harmonised reproducibly before classification.
limitations: The method still requires documentation of how workbook data were exported to batch CSVs and why any batch file was missing.

purpose: Creates the authoritative UTI/Not_UTI status using culture support and catheter-aware symptoms, while retaining legacy labels for audit.
inputs: results/clinical/intermediate/clinical_merged.rds; clinical helper functions; manual curation
filters_denominator: UTI requires culture support at >=1e3 CFU/mL and compatible symptoms. Non-indwelling: a local urinary symptom or flank pain plus a systemic symptom. Indwelling: a systemic symptom. All other episodes are Not_UTI with a subgroup. Current primary denominator: 583 episodes from 166 participants, 18 UTI and 565 Not_UTI.
tools_tests: Rule validation and duplicate-key assertions; no inferential test.
repeated_measures: Multiple raw rows are collapsed to one episode before classification.
outputs: results/clinical/status_map.csv and rule, movement, symptom and CFU audit tables
safe_claim: States exactly how each episode entered UTI or Not_UTI and preserves the classification rationale.
limitations: Not_UTI does not mean healthy or bacteria-free. Unknown evidence is generally retained as Not_UTI/indeterminate, so subgroup and confidence must be reported.

analysis_unit: Clinical episode, participant and assembly summary
purpose: Creates clinical denominator, reclassification, symptom-rule, CFU and assembly-context plots and tables.
inputs: results/clinical/status_map.csv; assembly_metadata.csv
filters_denominator: Uses the current primary status map and generated assembly metadata; does not redefine status.
tools_tests: Descriptive counts and graphics only.
repeated_measures: Participant counts are shown separately where relevant; no repeated-measures model.
outputs: plots/clinical/ and results/clinical summary CSVs
safe_claim: Visualises the clinical denominator and classification checks.
limitations: Does not support association or causal claims.

purpose: Derives poster-friendly timepoint labels and placement confidence using dates and event labels.
inputs: results/clinical/status_map.csv; available batch clinical files
filters_denominator: Preserves the primary status; uncertain/unplaced event rows are written to audits. Poster half-step positions are presentation metadata only.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: results/clinical/status_map_with_poster_tp.csv; unplaced/display-only event audit tables
safe_claim: Provides a transparent ordering aid for figures.
limitations: Poster timepoint numbers must never be used as biological elapsed time or as an inferential covariate.

purpose: Screens one selected assembly per episode against VFDB and builds a binary VF presence/absence matrix.
inputs: assembly_metadata.csv; results/qc/canonical_assembly_selection.csv; ABRicate VFDB
filters_denominator: Applies primary/genomics curation, requires a usable selected-canonical FASTA, and uses ABRicate minimum identity 80% and coverage 80%. Current mixed denominator: 556 rows, 162 participants and 227 detected VF columns.
tools_tests: ABRicate; prevalence summaries; no phenotype test.
repeated_measures: One row per selected episode prevents assembler alternatives being treated as independent samples.
outputs: results/vf/vf_hits_all.rds; results/vf/vf_pa_all.csv; gene prevalence tables and plots
safe_claim: Reports VFDB genes detected under the stated thresholds in selected assemblies.
limitations: Current primary output is not a union across Flye and Longcycler. Cache keys lack FASTA hashes and VFDB/tool versions are not recorded. Absence means not detected under this pipeline, not proven biological absence.

analysis_unit: Mixed episode, isolate, participant and pair outputs
purpose: Creates a broad collection of older VF, phylogeny, epidemiology, transmission, nitrate and timeline plots.
inputs: VF, status, MLST, tree, nitrate and pairwise outputs; optional batch metadata
filters_denominator: Uses whichever optional inputs exist and includes legacy-output branches.
tools_tests: Mostly descriptive plotting; any embedded comparisons are exploratory.
repeated_measures: Units and clustering vary by panel and are not controlled by one model.
outputs: Multiple legacy/exploratory files under plots/ and results/
safe_claim: May be used for internal exploration only.
limitations: Superseded by scripts 23-30; heterogeneous denominators and legacy ASB wording make it unsuitable as a current methods source.

classification: Gene curation and exploratory focus-gene analysis
purpose: Creates or reuses a gene-to-category map, category counts and nitrate summaries; also attempts focus-gene association models.
inputs: results/vf/vf_hits_all.rds; results/clinical/status_map.csv; results/vf/gene_map.csv when present
filters_denominator: Gene categories are reused if curated; otherwise assigned by ordered regex heuristics. Focus genes are joined to the clinical status table.
tools_tests: GLMM Outcome ~ gene + timepoint + batch + (1|Participant_id); singular fits accepted; GLM fallback; BH across focus genes.
repeated_measures: A participant random intercept is attempted only in the focus-gene subsection.
outputs: gene_map.csv; annotated/category/nitrate tables; diff_focus_genes_UTI_vs_Not_UTI_glmm.csv
safe_claim: The gene map is a transparent functional grouping aid; focus-gene results are exploratory.
limitations: When focus-gene calls are joined to all clinical rows, missing WGS/no hit may be filled as zero. Regex categories are not validated curation, and sparse/fallback models are not primary inference.

purpose: Calculates cohort prevalence and labels VF genes above 95% prevalence as dataset-level core and the remainder as variable.
inputs: results/vf/vf_pa_all.csv
filters_denominator: Uses only canonical binary VF columns and the sequenced selected denominator.
tools_tests: No statistical test; prevalence and heatmap clustering only.
repeated_measures: No repeated-measures adjustment because this is descriptive.
outputs: core_gene_list.txt; variable_gene_list.txt; prevalence and heatmap plots
safe_claim: Describes how frequently detected VF genes occur in the sequenced cohort.
limitations: Dataset-level core does not mean pangenome core, biological essentiality or protection from UTI.

analysis_unit: Canonical episode table plus all-isolate provenance
purpose: Builds the active provider-preferred MLST layer, using provider SeqSphere calls first and local MLST only as labelled fallback.
inputs: Provider-normalised MLST; local MLST provenance; assembly metadata and canonical selection through helper scripts
filters_denominator: Provider calls require PercGoodTargets >=95. Current mixed canonical table has 556 rows: 527 provider_qc95, 6 local fallbacks and 23 missing; 533 typed rows and 83 ST labels.
tools_tests: Provider/local source audit; no association test.
repeated_measures: One canonical episode row is used downstream; source provenance is retained.
outputs: mlst_provider_preferred.csv; mlst_provider_preferred_all.csv; mlst_provider_source_audit.csv
safe_claim: ST provides lineage context with an explicit typing source.
limitations: Provider assembler provenance often includes Flye even for Longcycler-selected episodes. The scheme/version and provider manifest are still needed; ST does not prove strain identity.

analysis_unit: Biological isolate after collapsing assembly alternatives
purpose: Summarises ST frequencies and top STs and creates an exploratory metadata join.
inputs: mlst_provider_preferred_all.csv when available, otherwise canonical MLST; assembly_metadata.csv
filters_denominator: Collapses to one row per Isolate_ID, preferring complete/more-locus calls. Current all-isolate source contains 1,291 assembly rows representing 593 isolates; the current frequency output contains 562 typed isolates and 90 STs.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Repeated episodes from the same participant remain distinct isolates.
outputs: ST_frequencies.csv; top20_STs plots; exploratory isolate metadata join
safe_claim: Describes isolate-level ST diversity.
limitations: This denominator differs from the 556 canonical episode table and must be labelled; it is not a participant-level temporal trend analysis.

purpose: Compares chromosomal ST with pMLST schemes when available, otherwise PlasmidFinder replicons, and screens ST-replicon associations.
inputs: mlst_provider_preferred.csv; canonical_assembly_selection.csv; selected FASTAs
filters_denominator: Uses selected canonical FASTAs; tests the five most common STs and replicons present in more than 5% of joined rows.
tools_tests: mlst/pMLST or ABRicate PlasmidFinder; Fisher exact tests with BH correction.
repeated_measures: Repeated episodes from the same participant are not clustered.
outputs: ST_core_freq.csv; pMLST or replicon tables; ST_plasmid_associations.csv
safe_claim: Generates hypothesis-forming ST-plasmid co-occurrence summaries.
limitations: The header label inferential-core is too strong. Tool availability changes the endpoint, database/version settings are not frozen, and Fisher tests violate independence when residents repeat.

purpose: Screens selected assemblies with PlasmidFinder and constructs replicon co-occurrence and ST-replicon networks.
inputs: canonical_assembly_selection.csv; selected FASTAs; provider-preferred MLST
filters_denominator: Requires selected canonical existing FASTAs. Network replicons must occur in at least three positive rows.
tools_tests: ABRicate PlasmidFinder; graph/network visualisation; no association model.
repeated_measures: No participant clustering.
outputs: plasmidfinder_input_manifest.csv; hits_long.csv; presence_absence.csv; network PDFs
safe_claim: Shows detected replicon patterns among screened assemblies.
limitations: Cache uses basename without content hash; no explicit identity/coverage option or DB version is logged. Zero-hit assemblies are absent from the matrix, so missing screening and true zero can be conflated downstream.

purpose: Creates a clustered replicon presence/absence heatmap annotated by ST.
inputs: plasmidfinder_presence_absence.csv; provider-preferred MLST
filters_denominator: Keeps replicons present in at least five matrix rows, or all if none meet the rule; groups rare STs.
tools_tests: ComplexHeatmap or pheatmap; no statistical test.
repeated_measures: No adjustment; descriptive only.
outputs: replicon_heatmap.pdf and .png
safe_claim: Visualises replicon distribution among rows represented in the matrix.
limitations: The input matrix may omit zero-hit selected assemblies; the heatmap denominator is therefore not automatically all 556 selected episodes.

runner_status: Sourced by scripts 11 and 16; not a standalone runner stage
purpose: Loads core tables, resolves assembly endpoints, runs/parses dnadiff and Mash, computes Jaccard similarities and applies a composite pair classification.
inputs: assembly metadata; canonical selection; MLST; VF and plasmid matrices; FASTAs
filters_denominator: The repaired design must require selected-canonical QC-pass endpoints and exact input fingerprints before cache reuse.
tools_tests: MUMmer dnadiff; Mash; set Jaccard; rule-based classification.
repeated_measures: Not a model; pair dependence is handled nowhere in the helper.
outputs: No standalone output; supplies functions used by pairwise scripts.
safe_claim: Supports reproducible pair metric calculation when exact input provenance is enforced.
limitations: The previous implementation fell back to noncanonical assemblies and reused SampleKey-only stale reports. Composite Same can pass missing accessory evidence and must not replace strict SNP evidence.

classification: Main comparative-genomics layer after cache repair
purpose: Calculates assembly-to-assembly strain-context metrics for every eligible within-resident pair.
inputs: Selected canonical QC-pass FASTAs; provider MLST; VF matrix; plasmid matrix
filters_denominator: Primary run should contain only current selected canonical endpoints. From the present 556 selected rows, the expected within-participant pair set is 963. Strict support is TotalSNPs <=25 and is reported separately from the composite class.
tools_tests: MUMmer dnadiff AvgIdentity/TotalSNPs; Mash distance; VF/plasmid Jaccard; exploratory Wilcoxon/Kruskal tests.
repeated_measures: Many pairs share participants and endpoints; the exploratory tests do not model this dependence.
outputs: pairwise_metrics.csv; pair summaries; exploratory statistics and plots
safe_claim: Reports fresh assembly-to-assembly dnadiff SNP differences and other concordance metrics with exact endpoint provenance.
limitations: dnadiff SNPs are not Parsnp core-genome SNPs or wgMLST alleles. The <=25 rule is operational, not universal. Pre-repair pairwise outputs were invalid because stale reports and noncanonical endpoints were reused; strict counts must be regenerated dynamically.

classification: Executed assembly QC and canonical selection
purpose: Measures assembly contiguity/size and deterministically selects one QC-passing assembly per episode, preferring Longcycler.
inputs: assembly_metadata.csv; existing FASTAs; primary/genomics curation
filters_denominator: Pass requires <=200 contigs, N50 >=20 kb, total size 4-6 Mb and no FASTA read error. Current active universe: 1,291 assembly records; selected mixed set: 556 rows/162 participants, 532 Longcycler and 24 Flye fallbacks.
tools_tests: seqinr metrics; Fisher exact QC-retention diagnostic.
repeated_measures: Selection produces one row per episode; Fisher does not cluster repeated resident episodes.
outputs: results/wgs/qc_summary.csv; results/qc/canonical_assembly_selection.csv; QC-bias tables and plot
safe_claim: Defines the executed mixed canonical denominator and the Longcycler-only sensitivity subset.
limitations: Completeness and contamination constants are not applied in this script. Passing is conditional on contiguity/size, not proof of biological completeness or absence of contamination.

purpose: Builds a Parsnp core alignment, SNP-distance matrix and neighbour-joining tree for selected canonical genomes.
inputs: canonical_assembly_selection.csv, falling back to QC summary; selected FASTAs
filters_denominator: Current manifest targets 556 selected QC-pass genomes. Pair labels use <=25 Same, <=1000 Related and >1000 Different for this separate output.
tools_tests: Parsnp -c -r ! -x; snp-dists; ape neighbour-joining.
repeated_measures: No phenotype repeated-measures model.
outputs: core_snp_input_manifest.csv; core alignment; snp_dists.tsv; strain_pairs.csv; core_genome.tree
safe_claim: Provides a separate cohort-wide core-genome phylogenetic context.
limitations: Script 11 does not consume this output despite stale header wording. Random reference selection and path/size/mtime fingerprints limit exact reproducibility; stale outputs can cause a warning and successful exit unless FORCE_RERUN_CORE_SNP=1.

purpose: Ensures a complete GFF inventory for selected genomes, regenerates missing Prokka annotations and runs Panaroo.
inputs: canonical selected FASTAs; existing/generated Prokka GFFs; assembly/GFF inventory
filters_denominator: Requires current metadata/QC and complete GFF coverage for selected QC-pass genomes; current intended denominator is 556.
tools_tests: Prokka --compliant --centre X --kingdom Bacteria --genus Escherichia --species coli; Panaroo --clean-mode strict --remove-invalid-genes.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: Panaroo manifest, GFF audits, gene_presence_absence.csv and other pangenome outputs
safe_claim: Describes pangenome/accessory-gene content conditional on the selected assemblies and annotation workflow.
limitations: Prokka/Panaroo versions are not frozen. Annotation and pangenome calls are assembly- and software-dependent.

purpose: Shows QC pass, canonical selection, GFF availability and Panaroo inclusion across batches, statuses, timepoints and assemblers.
inputs: qc_summary.csv; assembly_metadata.csv; canonical and Panaroo manifests; status_map.csv
filters_denominator: Uses the 1,291 active assembly records and distinguishes the 556 selected episode rows.
tools_tests: Descriptive plots; Fisher exact selection-by-status diagnostic.
repeated_measures: Repeated resident episodes are not clustered in the Fisher diagnostic.
outputs: Panaroo selection CSVs; QC-bias table; selection plots
safe_claim: Makes assembly and pangenome attrition visible.
limitations: Does not establish absence of selection bias, particularly with sparse UTI and repeated residents.

purpose: Screens genomic features and fits participant-random-intercept logistic models for UTI versus Not_UTI.
inputs: status_map.csv; vf_pa_all.csv; vf_analysis_ready.csv when current; plasmid matrix; MLST; canonical metadata
filters_denominator: Uses the mixed canonical VF/model denominator of 556 rows/162 participants: 17 UTI and 539 Not_UTI. Retains features with 5-95% prevalence; current output has 119 Fisher screens and 50 selected models.
tools_tests: Fisher screening; GLMM Outcome ~ feature + factor(Timepoint) + Batch + (1|Participant_id); singular fits accepted; GLM fallback; BH within selected models.
repeated_measures: A resident random intercept is used where the GLMM succeeds; fallback GLM loses clustering.
outputs: model_dataset_denominator.csv; gwas_univariable_stats.csv; gwas_multivariable_glmm.csv; warnings and plots
safe_claim: Provides exploratory adjusted estimates and explicit sparse-data diagnostics.
limitations: Only 17 UTI rows; two-stage data-driven selection followed by BH on the selected subset is not confirmatory. ST is not automatically adjusted. Current results have no FDR<0.05 findings, six singular fits and 37 sparse/separation flags.

runner_status: Invoked in Phase 3 but should be excluded from thesis claims
purpose: Assigns graph-component Strain_ID values from composite Same edges and produces timelines and switch candidates.
inputs: status_map or poster-status file; pairwise_metrics.csv
filters_denominator: Uses every clinical SampleKey as a graph vertex and composite Classification == Same as edges; orders by date/fallback.
tools_tests: igraph connected components; descriptive transitions.
repeated_measures: No repeated-event model.
outputs: participant_timelines.csv; transitions.csv; phenotype_switch_candidates.csv; persistence summaries and swimmer plot
safe_claim: At most an exploratory timeline after redesign.
limitations: No-WGS episodes become singleton Strain_IDs, connected-component transitivity can merge contradictory pairs, and composite Same is not strict SNP persistence. Current output includes the full 585-row audit status map rather than the primary genomic denominator.

purpose: Recomputes pair dnadiff metrics and lists VF/plasmid differences for phenotype-switch candidates.
inputs: phenotype_switch_candidates.csv; assembly metadata; VF and plasmid matrices
filters_denominator: Inherits script 15 candidates and resolves endpoint assemblies using script 11 helpers.
tools_tests: dnadiff; set differences; descriptive counts.
repeated_measures: No clustering or inferential model.
outputs: evolution_events.csv and summary text
safe_claim: None for the primary thesis until the candidate definition and provenance are repaired.
limitations: Inherits invalid graph candidates and historical cache risks; VF feature extraction can include metadata; missing plasmid rows can be treated as empty profiles.

purpose: Calculates the episode proportion classified UTI for common STs and screens each ST against all others.
inputs: status_map.csv; provider-preferred MLST; preferably vf_analysis_ready.csv
filters_denominator: Uses typed rows and STs with at least five episodes.
tools_tests: Fisher exact tests with BH; simple Wald-style plot intervals.
repeated_measures: Repeated episodes from the same resident are not clustered.
outputs: results/lineage/st_risk_profile.csv and plot
safe_claim: Describes UTI proportion by ST and exploratory over-representation.
limitations: Call the outcome a proportion, not risk. Sparse ST-by-UTI cells and repeated residents invalidate confirmatory interpretation.

analysis_unit: Variant record from a script-15 candidate pair
purpose: Parses dnadiff .snps files into position and substitution/indel tables.
inputs: phenotype_switch_candidates.csv; longitudinal dnadiff cache .snps files
filters_denominator: Keeps candidate-pair records and four principal position/base columns.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: annotated_snps.csv; variant_report.md
safe_claim: None for defensible mutation localisation in the current implementation.
limitations: Drops reference/query contig identifiers, so positions cannot be safely mapped on multi-contig assemblies; inherits invalid candidates and cache provenance.

purpose: Extracts collection method and a simple symptom summary for switch candidates.
inputs: phenotype_switch_candidates.csv; clinical_merged.rds
filters_denominator: Looks up candidate participant/timepoint rows and applies exact-value heuristics to raw symptom fields.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: No repeated-measures model.
outputs: host_context_table.csv
safe_claim: May support manual case review only.
limitations: Inherits invalid switch candidates; the heuristic may miss Dutch or differently encoded values. Antibiotic and broader host-factor data are absent, so confounding is not tested.

purpose: Overlays script-18 positions on a selected/preferred Prokka GFF and assigns the first overlapping gene.
inputs: annotated_snps.csv; transition case tables; canonical metadata; Prokka GFFs
filters_denominator: Restricts to Not_UTI-to-UTI candidates when available and SNP records; chooses a reference GFF by participant/timepoint.
tools_tests: Interval lookup; no statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: variant_annotation_detailed.csv
safe_claim: None for defensible gene-level mutation claims in the current implementation.
limitations: The upstream table lacks contig ID and this script ignores GFF seqid, allowing a contig-local coordinate to match the wrong contig; pair grouping can also mix To_Time values.

purpose: Creates a swimmer plot and a linear mutation map.
inputs: participant_timelines.csv; variant_annotation_detailed.csv
filters_denominator: Uses participants with multiple plotted timepoints and all available variant annotations.
tools_tests: Plotting only.
repeated_measures: No model.
outputs: Fig1_Swimmer_Plot.png; Fig2_Mutation_Map.png
safe_claim: No primary scientific claim.
limitations: Inherits scripts 15 and 20. It contains hard-coded highlight IDs and plots contig-local positions on an artificial 5 Mb line.

purpose: Joins VF calls, primary clinical status, gene categories and provider-preferred MLST; computes burden/category fields and an audited Uricult-to-UTI-N bridge.
inputs: vf_pa_all.csv; status_map.csv; gene_map.csv; mlst_provider_preferred.csv; canonical selection
filters_denominator: Applies primary/genomics curation. For a clinical Uricult episode, chooses one unmatched UTI-N WGS row by date then lowest UTI number, otherwise participant-only lowest number. Current mixed output: 556 rows/162 participants, 17 UTI and 539 Not_UTI.
tools_tests: Join/duplicate/freshness diagnostics; no association test.
repeated_measures: One row per selected episode; Uricult alternatives are written to sensitivity audit.
outputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; vf_binary_uti_ready.csv; bridge, gap and unmatched-row audits
safe_claim: Defines the executed mixed VF/model analysis denominator and transparent burden fields.
limitations: Header comments claiming union across assemblers are stale. MLST is not Longcycler-derived. Participant-only bridging is an assumption; alternatives must remain sensitivity. The 227 VFDB columns include unassigned/low-confidence genes, not only curated UPEC factors.

purpose: Summarises VF burden, prevalence and category counts by UTI status in the full cohort and follow-up-depth subsets.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; gene_map.csv
filters_denominator: Runs cohorts all, >=2, >=3 and >=4 timepoints; only rows with primary status enter status comparisons.
tools_tests: Gene/category Fisher tests and category Wilcoxon tests with BH where implemented.
repeated_measures: Repeated residents are not modelled; tests are explicitly exploratory.
outputs: VF burden, prevalence, enrichment tables and plots under results/vf and plots/vf
safe_claim: Reports medians, prevalence differences and exploratory screens.
limitations: Stratified files stack overlapping cohort subsets; use cohort == all for overall denominators. Sparse UTI, lineage and repeated residents limit interpretation.

classification: Main descriptive longitudinal layer after fresh pairwise rerun
purpose: Rebuilds within-resident adjacent pairs, computes VF Jaccard/detected changes, and layers dnadiff SNP and ST context.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; gene_map.csv; fresh pairwise_metrics.csv
filters_denominator: Orders by collection date, with labelled fallback for routine/event timepoints; uses consecutive observed retained rows. Current mixed full set: 394 transitions from 144 participants. Longcycler sensitivity must be rebuilt separately and currently has 371 transitions from 139 participants and nine Not_UTI-to-UTI transitions.
tools_tests: Set Jaccard and descriptive summaries; no causal or recurrent-event model.
repeated_measures: Each resident can contribute multiple correlated transitions; no inferential clustering is applied.
outputs: vf_longitudinal_transitions.csv; stratified and strain-context summaries; plots
safe_claim: Describes observed VF-profile stability and separately labels strict dnadiff SNP support after provenance repair.
limitations: Gained/lost means detected presence/absence difference, not proven acquisition/deletion. Adjacent retained samples are not continuous biology. Stratified outputs duplicate pairs, and strict SNP counts must be generated dynamically after the cache repair.

purpose: Checks whether VF burden varies by ST, within ST by status, and whether ST composition differs by status.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; gene_map.csv
filters_denominator: Uses STs with >=5 episodes, relaxing to >=3 if none qualify.
tools_tests: Kruskal-Wallis; within-ST Wilcoxon; simulated Fisher exact test with 10,000 replicates.
repeated_measures: Repeated residents are not clustered.
outputs: VF burden-by-ST tables, confounding summary and plots
safe_claim: Shows lineage structure that should inform cautious interpretation.
limitations: Non-significance cannot rule out confounding; sparse UTI and multiple test families limit power. Script 14 does not automatically add ST after this diagnostic.

purpose: Assigns genes to biological modules using ordered rules and builds episode module presence/count tables with confidence and review flags.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; gene_map.csv; raw VF matrix
filters_denominator: Rules are applied in order and first match wins; unassigned and low-confidence genes remain visible.
tools_tests: No association test.
repeated_measures: One module table row per episode; no inference.
outputs: gene_module_map.csv; module episode/summary/audit/review tables and plots
safe_claim: Provides a transparent, reproducible module framework for descriptive/sensitivity analyses.
limitations: Hand-authored regex modules are not externally validated systems and should not be interpreted as causal or predictive.

purpose: Calculates descriptive VF burden, ExPEC-like marker and UPEC-system endpoints plus PCA/PCoA and status/ST summaries.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; gene_module_map.csv; module episode table
filters_denominator: Uses current primary VF-ready episodes and defined supplementary marker/system rules.
tools_tests: Fisher marker tests; Wilcoxon score tests; Spearman correlations; PCA and Jaccard PCoA; BH within output families.
repeated_measures: Repeated residents are not adjusted in episode-level tests.
outputs: vf_score_table.csv; marker, score, correlation, PCA/PCoA tables and plots
safe_claim: Provides descriptive and hypothesis-generating supplementary endpoints.
limitations: Not validated prediction scores. Literature mapping requires citation; sparse UTI, repeated residents and multiple families prevent confirmatory claims.

purpose: Builds all ordered clinical transitions, retains missing genomics and layers VF/module/score/ST/pairwise evidence where available.
inputs: status map; vf_analysis_ready; pairwise metrics; module, score and longitudinal outputs
filters_denominator: Orders clinical episodes by date, then documented fallback; marks endpoint availability and isolates Not_UTI-to-UTI cases without requiring WGS.
tools_tests: Descriptive case classification only.
repeated_measures: Residents may contribute multiple transitions; no recurrent-event model.
outputs: vf_transition_case_index/summary, change tables, notes, summary and plots
safe_claim: Provides a complete clinical-first transition inventory with explicit missing-data context.
limitations: Its denominator differs from VF-only script 24. Case classes do not identify causes; all SNP-dependent fields require the repaired fresh pairwise table.

classification: VF plus plasmid exploratory analysis; not AMR
purpose: Audits whether dedicated AMR results exist and otherwise combines VF endpoints with plasmid-replicon summaries.
inputs: vf_analysis_ready.csv; vf_score_table.csv; plasmid/replicon tables; optional AMR directories
filters_denominator: Current logic records amr_data_available and true_amr_integration_performed as false and performs VF-plasmid summaries.
tools_tests: Descriptive summaries and Spearman VF-replicon correlations.
repeated_measures: Repeated residents are not clustered.
outputs: results/vf_amr combined/profile/replicon tables and plots; availability report
safe_claim: Can support VF-plasmid context only.
limitations: Despite filenames, it does not perform a true antibiotic or AMR analysis. Missing plasmid matches may be filled as zero, and database-screening absence must not be interpreted as susceptibility.

purpose: Collects generated clinical, WGS, MLST, VF, transition and sensitivity outputs into numbered summary tables and a markdown report.
inputs: Current outputs from preceding scripts; optional extensions
filters_denominator: Performs file-availability and selected freshness/denominator checks; does not create a new primary analysis.
tools_tests: No new core statistical model.
repeated_measures: Inherits the repeated-measures handling of each input.
outputs: results/summary/table_*.csv; final summary markdown; optional XLSX/RDS; QC log
safe_claim: Can provide a traceable index of current generated outputs after upstream validation.
limitations: The manuscript-ready label is too strong. It propagates stale or unsupported upstream content unless the input set is repaired and claims are manually bounded.

purpose: Inventories project FASTAs against metadata, QC, MLST, VF, GFF and Panaroo representation and flags conflicts or stale references.
inputs: DIR_FASTAS; assembly metadata/list; QC, MLST, VF and GFF/Panaroo outputs
filters_denominator: Scans recursively and classifies expected, excluded, duplicated and assembler-conflict cases; strict failure is enabled by default.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: fasta_usage_audit.csv; summary; conflict, batch and GFF/Panaroo audit tables
safe_claim: Documents whether sequenced assemblies are visible to each pipeline layer.
limitations: File-audit counts include classified exclusions and are not biological denominators. Results must be dated and rerun after file changes.

analysis_unit: Clinical UTI episode and attrition stage
purpose: Traces UTI episodes through metadata, FASTA, QC, VF and MLST layers and records reasons for loss.
inputs: status_map; assembly/QC; VF hits/matrix; MLST and related audit files
filters_denominator: Diagnostic only; does not change labels or primary inclusion.
tools_tests: No inferential test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: results/audit UTI cascade, missing-row, rule and denominator tables
safe_claim: Explains factual UTI attrition when run against current files.
limitations: Older generated copies contain obsolete denominators; freshness must be checked and the audit rerun before citation.

analysis_unit: Episode, participant or transition depending endpoint
purpose: Explains denominator flow and near-miss rows, estimates sparse-case uncertainty and performs leave-one, paired and transition diagnostics.
inputs: status_map; vf_analysis_ready; score/module/transition and model outputs
filters_denominator: Hard-validates the executed mixed counts of 18/565 clinical and 17/539 VF. Uses selected score and feature sets.
tools_tests: Resident bootstrap B=1,000; exploratory Fisher; leave-one-UTI; paired sign/binomial and Wilcoxon tests; approximate power context.
repeated_measures: Bootstrap resamples residents and paired summaries collapse within resident; Fisher and transition tests do not fully account for repetition.
outputs: results/audit and results/vf diagnostic tables plus plots
safe_claim: Quantifies uncertainty and fragility for the mixed 556-row analysis.
limitations: Cannot be applied unchanged to the Longcycler sensitivity. Some features are data-selected, transition observations can repeat, and the power grid is illustrative rather than prospective.

purpose: Combines clinical context, strain evidence, VF/modules, accessory genes, plasmids, variants and optional ResFinder screening into a casebook.
inputs: script-28 outputs; status/VF; fresh pairwise metrics; Panaroo; plasmid, variant and optional ABRicate inputs
filters_denominator: Uses Not_UTI-to-UTI transition cases and selected canonical FASTAs for optional ResFinder screening at 80% identity/coverage.
tools_tests: Rule-based descriptive buckets; optional ABRicate ResFinder; no causal model.
repeated_measures: Residents can contribute multiple cases; no recurrent-event adjustment.
outputs: results/mechanism casebook, summaries, validations, optional AMR tables and plots
safe_claim: Provides structured descriptive case evidence after all upstream provenance checks pass.
limitations: Does not establish a mechanism or antibiotic effect. Cache is basename-based, variant annotation is unsafe, optional AMR data are not clinical antibiotic exposure, and input case counts must be dynamic.

analysis_unit: Episode, score or existing model result
purpose: Compares the primary rule with a near-miss-expanded sensitivity and consolidates QC, model, bootstrap, leave-one and power diagnostics.
inputs: status_map; vf_analysis_ready; score table; near-miss, QC, model and script-32 outputs
filters_denominator: Hard-validates 583/18 clinical, 556/17 VF and the current near-miss count; near-miss labels change only within sensitivity outputs.
tools_tests: Wilcoxon and Fisher with BH for selected new comparisons; otherwise summary of upstream diagnostics.
repeated_measures: New episode-level tests do not fully cluster residents; inherited bootstrap/paired handling varies.
outputs: results/robustness tables, claim matrix, validation, markdown and plots
safe_claim: Shows how sparse-case conclusions change under a documented possible-UTI sensitivity.
limitations: Mixed analysis only; does not refit all feature GLMMs under the alternative rule and remains exploratory.

purpose: Renders final figures from mechanism, robustness and statistical-sensitivity outputs after validation checks.
inputs: Status, VF, mechanism, robustness, statistical-sensitivity and variant outputs
filters_denominator: Requires upstream validation status PASS and rejects some legacy paths.
tools_tests: No new inference; plotting only.
repeated_measures: Inherits all clustering choices from upstream analyses.
outputs: plots/final_figures and final figure manifest/validation tables
safe_claim: Can render already validated descriptive or sensitivity results.
limitations: Contains hard-coded mixed denominators and transition/interpretation text and includes unsafe variant/AMR branches. It is not a methods source and must be regenerated after corrected inputs.

analysis_unit: Participant-collapsed status, paired resident, transition and episode model
purpose: Adds resident-collapsed score comparisons, paired binary features, transition module contrasts and score-level GLMM sensitivities.
inputs: status_map; vf_analysis_ready; vf_score_table; prior feature/model screens; transition/module outputs
filters_denominator: Uses four named score endpoints. Feature catalogue combines top prior results with explicit example genes; score GLMMs use batch, timepoint and optional collapsed ST groups.
tools_tests: Bootstrap B=5,000; rank-sum, sign and signed-rank tests with BH; Fisher with BH; GLMM + (1|Participant_id) with GLM fallback.
repeated_measures: Participant-collapsed and paired analyses address repetition; transition tests can repeat residents and GLM fallback loses clustering.
outputs: results/statistical_sensitivity tables, validation, summary and plots
safe_claim: Provides targeted sensitivity evidence and makes sparse-data limitations visible.
limitations: Prespecified is inaccurate for the data-selected feature catalogue. Seventeen UTI rows with multiple factor levels can overfit; ST grouping is hard-coded and all results remain exploratory.

runner_status: Executed manually to run the numbered workflow
purpose: Runs clinical, WGS-from-assemblies, VF, pairwise, longitudinal, exploratory and reporting scripts in a fixed shell order.
inputs: Pre-existing batch CSVs, assembly_metadata.csv, FASTAs, software environment and all script dependencies
filters_denominator: Uses set -e and set -u and requires some conda environment to be active. It does not verify the intended environment name or run the metadata builder.
tools_tests: No test itself; invokes tests/models embedded in scripts.
repeated_measures: Inherited from each invoked script.
outputs: All outputs listed by invoked scripts; console execution log only unless externally captured
safe_claim: Documents the actual order of the executed assembly-to-results workflow.
limitations: Not a raw-read-to-results pipeline: it omits sequencing, basecalling, read QC, coverage, Longcycler/Flye assembly and polishing, and 00_make_assembly_metadata.r. It invokes unsupported scripts 15-21, does not freeze versions, and Parsnp may exit successfully while leaving stale output.

purpose: Screens assemblies excluded only for size using additional quality, taxonomy and distance evidence without changing canonical QC.
inputs: canonical selection and candidate FASTAs; optional CheckM2, GUNC, QUAST, MLST, Mash and FCS-GX resources
filters_denominator: Retains the canonical set and adds only candidates meeting explicitly configured rescue evidence; default maximum rescue size 6.8 Mb.
tools_tests: External QC/taxonomy/distance tools subject to availability.
repeated_measures: One sensitivity assembly selection per episode; no phenotype model.
outputs: results/sensitivity/rescue_qc/ manifests, tool results, decisions and selection file
safe_claim: Can support a separately labelled assembly-QC sensitivity analysis.
limitations: Tool availability changes available evidence; never merge rescue rows into the primary canonical denominator without explicit sensitivity labelling.

purpose: Compares canonical and bad-size-rescue VF-ready datasets, denominators and matched VF profiles.
inputs: Primary vf_analysis_ready.csv; rescue vf_analysis_ready_rescue.csv; rescue selection
filters_denominator: Keeps primary and rescue datasets labelled and identifies rescue-only, primary-only and shared episode keys.
tools_tests: Descriptive comparisons; no primary inferential model.
repeated_measures: Matched rows can be compared within episode; no broader resident model.
outputs: results/sensitivity/vf_rescue comparison tables and report
safe_claim: Shows whether optional QC rescue materially changes VF denominators or calls.
limitations: Sensitivity only; does not validate rescued assemblies or justify replacing the canonical analysis.

purpose: Parses the first 100 comment lines of active root and non-legacy utility scripts to create a script index.
inputs: Numbered root scripts and top-level scripts/ utilities
filters_denominator: Includes files matching configured filename patterns; extracts header tags heuristically.
tools_tests: No statistical test.
repeated_measures: Not applicable.
outputs: results/meta/script_and_figure_index.csv
safe_claim: Provides a navigational index of scripts.
limitations: Header comments can be stale or incomplete; this generated index is not a substitute for the audited register.
